proposal.reason: Main functional change is in P2P transport IPC registration/deregistration (src/transport/p2p.cc, proxy interaction) to support multi-segment buffer export/import, FD transfer, and lifecycle cleanup. Add memory because segment-aware allocation mapping/unmapping and free/ownership semantics are substantively changed in src/include/alloc.h (numSegments handling, granularity validation, multi-segment unmap/free paths).
